cornerstone.full_quote: Each Cornerstone Investor has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period commencing from the Listing Date and ending on (and inclusive of) the date falling six (6) months starting from and inclusive of the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that it has purchased pursuant to the Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six (6) months counted from and inclusive of the Listing Date; restricted period inclusive of the Listing Date and ends (inclusive) on the last day of the six-month span, i.e. the day before the six-month anniversary
cornerstone.notes: Section 'RESTRICTIONS ON DISPOSALS BY THE CORNERSTONE INVESTORS', page headed CORNERSTONE INVESTORS - 255 -. Wording uses 'six (6) months starting from and inclusive of the Listing Date' rather than a plain 'six months from the Listing Date'.

controller_6m.full_quote: Pursuant to Rule 10.07(1) of the Listing Rules, each of the Controlling Shareholders has irrevocably and unconditionally undertaken to the Stock Exchange, our Company, the Joint Sponsors and the Sponsor-overall Coordinators that, except in compliance with the requirements of the Listing Rules, he/it will not and will procure that the relevant registered holder(s) will not, either directly or indirectly: (i) in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of his/its holding of Shares is made in this Prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the “First Six-Month Period”), dispose of, nor enter
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(a): no disposal in the First Six-Month Period ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date; first free day = six-month anniversary
controller_6m.notes: Quote ends mid-sentence because the clause runs over the page break; page 301 continues 'into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares in respect of which he/it is shown by this Prospectus to be the beneficial owner (the “Relevant Securities”)'.

controller_12m.full_quote: (ii) in the period of six months commencing from the expiry of the First Six-Month Period (the “Second Six-Month Period”), dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any such Shares referred to in (1) above if, immediately following such disposal, or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, he/it would cease to be a Controlling Shareholder of the Company.
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b): no disposal in the Second Six-Month Period (months 6-12) to the extent it would cause cessation of Controlling Shareholder status; effective 12-month restriction from Listing Date
